# Owned media fixtures

These fixtures contain synthetic pixels generated by `generate.go`. Source
quadrants are red, green, blue, yellow, each opaque; JPEG EXIF tests construct
their own minimal orientation IFD at runtime.
Tests embed the files, so the same corpus runs in the isolated runtime image.

To regenerate, run `go run generate.go` in this directory. The current encoder
profile is Ubuntu 26.04 `libheif-examples`, `libheif-plugin-x265` and
`libheif-plugin-aomenc`, version `1.21.2-3ubuntu0.7`. These are fixture-generation
dependencies. The application image uses its pinned FFmpeg package.

The HEIC/AVIF inputs include single images, a cropped four-tile grid, a 24-tile
grid, a primary with a thumbnail, primary
rotation, both mirroring axes, HDR transfer and auxiliary alpha. Unsupported
conversions are asserted as errors with retained input and absent output.

The transform fixtures replace a color property in the owned grid while keeping
all box lengths and media offsets unchanged. Only primary item 1 references the
transform; other items reuse their existing pixel property. Tile streams retain
their original orientation. The layout and pixel expectations are independent
of the application. `heif-info` and `heif-convert`
1.21.2/libde265 independently confirmed primary rotation/mirroring, including
`imir=0` exchanging top/bottom and `imir=1` exchanging left/right.

Encoded bytes may depend on encoder builds. Ordinary tests use the checked-in
fixtures. Regenerate fixtures explicitly with the encoder profile above.
